description: This PHP source file defines the Installer controller class in the Opencart admin marketplace module. It handles file uploads, installation, uninstallation, listing, and deletion of marketplace extensions (mods) within the Opencart platform.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Main controller class for managing extension installations, including upload, installation, uninstallation, and listing of marketplace extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default view rendering for the installer page, including breadcrumb setup and loading the view template.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of installed extensions as a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of extensions, reads marketplace ZIP files, and manages pagination.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles upload and validation of extension ZIP files, including extraction of install.json and adding the extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs incremental installation of an extension from ZIP, extracting files and updating installation status.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a new vendor autoloader file to support vendor extensions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes extension files, directories, and database entries to uninstall an extension.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the uploaded ZIP file and its database record for a given extension.
